scientific_integrity: Self-contained graph proof with independently replayable finite tests; no claim of external expert certification or complete publication-priority search.
scientific_limitations: Exact for \(K_2\square K_2\square K_n\) with \(n\ge2\). The incidence EGF counts distinct labeled two-regular multigraphs realizable by perfect geodesic packings, not all perfect path-packings. Priority is evaluated against accessible records and not independently established; larger Hamming products remain open in this work.
title: Parity and even-cycle structure of perfect geodesic packings in binary-slab Hamming graphs
